critical_code_review_comments: INFO: _strip_secrets() in student_routes.py correctly hides both correct_option AND diagram_description pre-submit — good defense in depth.

INFO: _grade_test() counts total marks across ALL questions but only awards for MCQ format; with format_distribution mcq=100 this is fine, but if non-MCQ leak in (LLM quirk) total would over-count. Currently safe because the prompt enforces mcq=100; consider asserting at insert time that every question.format=='mcq' for is_mock_test=true papers.

INFO: Mock test was created with question_count=5 but the seeded paper had 8 questions — that's a worker/LLM quirk (count is a target, not a hard contract). Not a bug per spec, but consider clamping at worker level if exact count matters to UX.
INFO: PATCH /answers refuses writes after ends_at (good) AND auto-marks status=expired in the same call — race-safe.

MINOR: student_routes.py mock_test_result() auto-grades on expired-without-submit. Good. But it does not record submitted_at in that path — score is set but the test stays status=expired forever. Acceptable, but worth a comment.
INFO: New code is well-scoped (~417 LOC), readable, has docstrings; no _id leaks; pydantic validation on all inputs.
